# RiboScanner master-table analysis

This workflow has been converted to a plain R script to avoid R Markdown
dependencies on headless SLURM nodes (`pandoc`, `X11`, HTML rendering devices).

Run the analysis through:

```bash
bash submit_riboscanner_master_analysis.sh test
bash submit_riboscanner_master_analysis.sh full
```

The executable analysis code is in:

```text
riboscanner_master_analysis.R
```

Outputs are written to the RiboScanner project directory:

```text
riboscanner_analysis*/figures/
riboscanner_analysis*/*.tsv
```
